--- content spec/Pc.tla
---- MODULE Pc ----
EXTENDS Naturals
(*--algorithm Pc
variable x = 0;
begin
  x := x + 1;
  x := x + 1;
end algorithm; *)
\* BEGIN TRANSLATION (chksum(pcal) = "5033aa84" /\ chksum(tla) = "3128576b")
VARIABLES pc, x

vars == << pc, x >>

Init == (* Global variables *)
        /\ x = 0
        /\ pc = "Lbl_1"

Lbl_1 == /\ pc = "Lbl_1"
         /\ x' = x + 1
         /\ pc' = "Lbl_2"

Lbl_2 == /\ pc = "Lbl_2"
         /\ x' = x + 1
         /\ pc' = "Done"

(* Allow infinite stuttering to prevent deadlock on termination. *)
Terminating == pc = "Done" /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == Lbl_1 \/ Lbl_2
           \/ Terminating

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Termination == <>(pc = "Done")

\* END TRANSLATION 
====
